thread:
lina: heads-up — customer acme-inc reporting intermittent 401s on SSO after last IdP cert rotation. started ~0300 UTC.
ben: seeing same in logs: lots of `InvalidDestination` but only for some assertion attempts. other requests OK.
ingrid: any recent infra changes? cert rotations?
lina: customer rotated signing cert on their IdP last night. they said they uploaded new metadata but might have left the old EntityDescriptor entry too.
javier: can you paste the metadata URL? i want to curl it.
lina: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml — when i fetch i get two <EntityDescriptor> blocks for the same entityID, each with different <KeyDescriptor use=\"signing\"> X509Certificates.
ben: aha — our metadata poller picks first match, but sometimes the CDN returns the other entry (order unstable). that would explain intermittent 401 when SP selects wrong signing key to validate.
support-bot: Incident created: SUPPORT-1246 — "Intermittent SSO 401 after IdP rotation (duplicate EntityDescriptor)"
sre-oncall: repro steps?
lina: steps i used: 1) curl -sS https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --format - 2) grep -n "EntityDescriptor" -
javier: i also did: 
```
curl -sS -H "Cache-Control: no-cache" https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | sed -n '1,200p'
```
shows two descriptors with same entityID and different certs.
ben: workaround for now: force metadata refresh for that tenant and mark the expected fingerprint in our tenant config (manual override). not ideal but buys time.
ingrid: is our poller honoring Cache-Control / ETag? could we detect duplicate entityIDs and log an error?
sre-oncall: yes, poller uses ETag but we don't validate uniqueness of entityID across descriptors. we should add a probe that rejects metadata with duplicate entityIDs or at least emits WARNING and prefers descriptor with valid signing role.
lina: customer confirmed they pushed a metadata bundle (their idp admin). they're going to remove the duplicate. but they said the upload process to their IdP backend sometimes leaves a stale descriptor.
javier: proposed change: when parsing metadata, if multiple EntityDescriptor with same entityID, pick the one where <IDPSSODescriptor> is present and KeyDescriptor/@use=="signing" AND certificate matches any cert in the old trusted list, else log full fingerprint list and fallback to most recent valid time.
ben: quick patch we can ship: add a check that rejects metadata where entityID duplicates are present and send an alert to ops + tenant owner. then escalate to customer success to ask IdP vendor to fix their metadata generator.
sre-oncall: rollout idea: feature flag the stricter validator to on for a few tenants first.
lina: i posted repro logs and a sample bad metadata snippet to the ticket.
ben: logs include these snippets: 
```
2026-03-18T03:02:11Z ERROR SAML validation failed: Signature verification failed, tried keys: [SHA256:aa:bb:cc, SHA256:dd:ee:ff]
2026-03-18T03:02:11Z WARN metadata: duplicate entityID detected for urn:acme:idp at lines 12 and 243
```
ingrid: customer asked if we can automatically accept either cert during rotation window. that makes me uneasy long-term but maybe a short-term option with strict TTL.
sre-oncall: can implement a 6-hour grace window where we accept either cert if fingerprint matches one of the two in metadata and extra audit logs are emitted. must be opt-in per tenant.
javier: ACTIONS: 1) lina to add repro snippet + curl commands to SUPPORT-1246 (done). 2) ben to open a small PR for metadata duplicate detection and a feature-flagged grace acceptance (ETA 4h). 3) sre-oncall to add alert rule for duplicate entityID (ETA 1h). 4) ingrid to coordinate with customer success and Acme IdP admin.
lina: Acme admin says they'll remove the stale EntityDescriptor tonight. they asked for short-term opt-in.
ben: i'll start the PR and include tests: malformed metadata, duplicate but identical certs, duplicate different certs.
sre-oncall: created alert: metadata.duplicate_entityid.count > 0 -> page oncall.
ingrid: customer success updated ticket: "Acme will clean metadata; interim accept-either-cert enabled for tenant acme-inc."
lina: enabling opt-in now, will watch for errors.
support-bot: Update: SUPPORT-1246 status changed to "monitoring"
ben: follow-up: we should also document this kind of IdP vendor bug in the SSO troubleshooting guide with the curl/xmllint steps and recommended vendor fix.
javier: agreed — i'll draft a short KB.
lina: resolution note to close once 24h stable with no 401s.
sre-oncall: marking follow-up tasks in backlog: METADATA-23 (duplicate detection), METADATA-24 (opt-in grace).
ben: thanks team :thumbsup:
lina: thanks — keeping ticket open until customer confirms.
